name: inferred-unit
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.inferred-projection.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; bun test research/bapa/inferred-projection.test.ts research/bapa/source-projection.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; printf '%s\n' 'feat(bapa): project same-machine inferred families' > "$OUT/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$OUT/commit-message.txt" > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1

name: inferred-lockserv
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/proof-emit.ts --capture inferred-lockserv --sha256 f5bfd1e13863bdf318e638ae398d26629899b637914bfa6db2283d12ef7a1ee0 --out "$OUT/project" --projection alpha > "$OUT/emission.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/project"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$OUT/lean.log" BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/axioms.log" 2>&1

name: inferred-lockserv_automaton
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/proof-emit.ts --capture inferred-lockserv_automaton --sha256 8a0fa118813b55b492e1d79fcb056664a548d3a783885e98d83446b895c1b8f6 --out "$OUT/project" --projection alpha > "$OUT/emission.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/project"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$OUT/lean.log" BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/axioms.log" 2>&1
